lines.text: Every successful organisation shares one common strength… its people.
At OQ RPI, behind every operation, every innovation, and every achievement, lies talent.
OQ RPI 2030 Transformation has a clear direction: strengthening the core, while embracing the future.
At its heart, the People and Culture pillar commits us to one outcome Talent Management exists to deliver: a future-ready organization.
Every Talent Management programme is part of that strategy.
In a fast-changing energy sector, OQ RPI must have the right talent, in the right roles, at the right time.
That means knowing which roles are critical, who is ready to step into them, and where capability must be built.
OQ RPI Talent Management exists to build sustainable workforce capability, strengthen our leadership pipeline, and secure the future of our business.
At OQ RPI, Talent Management is not a collection of separate programmes. It is one integrated ecosystem.
Brought together in our Talent Command Center, each programme generates insights, actions and data that strengthen the next, all aimed at one goal: a future-ready organization.
Performance Management enables us to assess, measure, and recognise employee contribution while supporting strategic talent decisions.
It is the foundation for every talent decision we make, and for the performance-driven culture our 2030 Transformation calls for.
Through our annual Talent Review, the 9-Box Matrix combines performance and potential to identify our future leaders and accelerate their development.
Not every position carries the same level of risk.
Our Critical Roles framework identifies the positions whose vacancy would impact safety, operations, leadership continuity, or business performance.
Succession Planning identifies successors for critical positions, then develops them until they are ready, to support business continuity.
Leadership development programmes such as MASAR and ROBBAN build future leaders and strengthen organisational capability.
Nationalization develops and advances Omani talent into critical roles and leadership positions, with a named successor for every role we nationalize.
Through Secondment Management, OQ RPI employees gain broader exposure across OQ and national institutions, accelerating their learning and bringing new capability home.
Rewards and Recognition, from Testahal to Above and Beyond, reinforces the behaviours we value and celebrates the people who make our success possible.

The OQ RPI Talent Command Center is the central platform that brings it all together: Performance Management, Succession Planning, Critical Roles, Leadership Development, Nationalization, Secondment, and Rewards and Recognition, giving every leader real-time visibility.
And our Talent Assistant answers any question on talent data, in English or Arabic.
Together, these initiatives form the OQ RPI Talent Management ecosystem, transforming data into decisions, potential into capability, and employees into future leaders.
For every employee, it means clear expectations, real development, and a visible path to grow with OQ RPI.
The future is not built by systems. It is built by people.

By investing in our people today, OQ RPI is protecting critical capability, building its next generation of leaders, and advancing Omani talent, the future-ready organization our 2030 Transformation calls for.
OQ RPI Talent Management. Building tomorrow's talent, together.
